title: I Love People-Watching!
creator: VOA Learning English
summaryTr: Anna, arkadaşlarıyla parkta insanları gözlemlerken işe dönme saatini unutuyor. Patronu görünce başlayan saklanma çabası, küçük bir sürprizle bitiyor.

captions.text: Hello! People from all over the world come to Washington, D.C.
When I'm at work, I love eating lunch outside.
I like to watch people walking by. They all look very different.
Today, my friend Ashley is eating lunch with me.
Ashley, today the weather is beautiful, isn't it?
Yes, it is. Ahh. Ooh, we have to return to work!
No, we have time! Let's people-watch a little more.
Okay.
Oh, I know her. She works in my office! Keyana, hi!
Come and join us!
Hi Anna, how are you?
I'm doing great! Keyana, this is my friend Ashley.
Hi, Ashley!
We need to return to work.
But the weather is beautiful and people-watching is fun!
I love people-watching too!
Well, have a seat!
It is fun to see how people are different or the same.
It is. For example, Anna, you are tall. But Ashley and I are short.
And Keyana, you and Ashley have brown eyes; I have blue eyes.
You two have light skin and I have dark skin.
Ashley, you have straight hair. Keyana and I have curly hair.
You have very curly hair, Anna.
I need to return to work. See you, Anna! Nice to meet you Ashley!
Bye, Keyana!
Anna, I have to go, too. Are you returning to work?
I still have time. And this sun feels so good!
Um, Anna, what does your boss look like?
She is short. She has straight, light hair.
Does she wear glasses?
Yes. Yes, she does.
Is she wearing a blue sweater today?
How do you know that?
She's coming this way.
Oh no! Hide me!
Um, bye Anna. Call me later.
Bye, Ashley! Talk to you later!
Anna? Is that you?
Ms. Weaver! Hi!
What are you doing behind that bench?
I am looking for my, my ... stick. Here it is.
I am people-watching. Oh! But it's time to return to work!
No need to hurry. I love people-watching too! Let's sit!
Sure!
Ahh.
It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
Yes. Yes, it is, Ms. Weaver.
People-watching in D.C. is fun. It makes me forget the time!
Until next time! Ahh.
